import os
import sys


def main():

        data = f.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")

    lines = data.split("\n")
    # The text ends with a newline, so the final split piece is empty; drop it.
    if lines and lines[-1] == "":
        lines.pop()

    e = w = i = 0
    for line in lines:
        level = line.split(" ", 1)[0]
        if level == "ERROR":
            e += 1
        elif level == "WARN":
            w += 1
        elif level == "INFO":
            i += 1

    os.makedirs("out", exist_ok=True)
    with open(os.path.join("out", "levels.txt"), "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as f:
        f.write("ERROR=%d\n" % e)
        f.write("WARN=%d\n" % w)
        f.write("INFO=%d\n" % i)

    if e >= 1:
        sys.stdout.write("alert not sent: %d errors\n" % e)
        sys.stdout.flush()

    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
